intent-aware retrieval models can be used to improve search result diversification, and that the best diversification approach depends on the type of query and the type of aspect.
intent-aware diversification is a promising direction for diversifying search results.
Intent-aware search result diversity can be achieved by applying intent-aware retrieval approaches when diversifying search results.

diversification of search results in order to satisfy different information needs underlying a single query.

we propose an intent-aware search result diversi?cation method, which can be applied to any retrieval model and can be used to diversify the search results of the most widely used retrieval models, such as BM25, language models and the probabilistic relevance model.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the choice of retrieval model should be tailored to the underlying aspects of a query, in the sense that a model which is appropriate for a given aspect may not necessarily be appropriate for a different aspect.

, in the context of search result diversification, it is not only important to diversify the ranking, but also to diversify the retrieval models used to estimate the relevance of documents with respect to each of the underlying aspects.
, by combining intent-aware retrieval with result diversification, it is possible to improve the effectiveness of search result diversification, while preserving its main benefits.
